frozen_rule_order: R1 EXPECTANCY: after-cost expectancy > 0 per decision at the frozen tier-2.0 cost treatment (PRIMARY), on the identical bookable grid and window.

R2 CONTROL_KILL (declared executioner, V8 law adapted): the MANDATORY level-vs-shape decomposition control arm earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the anchor arm it is paired against -> the family fails; the clock-only shadow and the misaligned-state placebo carry the same out-earning kill semantics as secondary executioners (D1 falsification rule).

R3 FOLDS: at least 2 of 3 temporal folds with positive after-cost expectancy; folds frozen by equal calendar-day thirds of the bookable window 2019-01-07..2026-09-11 (2804 days); force-flat at fold ends.
R4 PROFIT FACTOR: profit factor >= 1.10 with margin recorded (P-2).
R5 STRESS: after-cost expectancy under the stress-tier cost treatment still > 0 (single-tier ladder: coincides with R1; retained for rule-order fidelity, never silently dropped).
R6 NON_CONCENTRATION: drop-one-fold survival + no single decision instant contributing more than 50% of gross (unit adapted from the precedent's 'event' to 'decision instant').
